# ConClear conformance

<!-- Generated by python -m conclear.conformance. Do not edit by hand. -->

ConClear implements the automatable rules of the foundata
[OCI container image build and release guide](https://github.com/foundata/guidelines/blob/1082f52c72e26a21b9cf10df3e79cb2f293d77a5/oci-container-image-guide.md)
at revision `1082f52c72e26a21b9cf10df3e79cb2f293d77a5`. Manual entries identify
requirements that still need human judgment.

## Built-in limits

Repository configuration may shorten these limits but cannot extend or disable
them.

|                Limit                 | Maximum |
| ------------------------------------ | ------: |
| Pin resolution freshness             | 24 hours |
| Pin divergence                       |  7 days |
| Candidate lifetime                   |  7 days |
| Fixable HIGH or CRITICAL remediation | 30 days |

## Retired identifiers

No identifiers are retired.
